findings.statement: Rank 1 in the target profile (score 4.1314, 5 streams). Open Targets association with ccRCC is 0.4049 (genetic association 0.519). No drugs are listed. The protein is at the cell membrane (caveola), so it is antibody-accessible. TCGA log2FC is 3.989 with padj 1.43e-31, and protein log2FC is 1.837. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency (mean effect 0.002, selectivity -0.021), so this is a biomarker or surface-antigen case, not a dependency-driven target. Tractable but untested.

Rank 2 in the target profile (score 3.9871). TCGA log2FC is 9.712 and protein log2FC is 2.269. It sits at the cell membrane and microvillus membrane, which is suitable for antibodies and imaging. Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_3, IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_2, SULTHIAME PHASE_4, ETHOXZOLAMIDE WITHDRAWAL. Open Targets association score is 0.3088, driven by literature. DepMap shows no dependency (mean effect 0.051), and the somatic mutation frequency is 0.002. This makes it a strong biomarker and antigen but a weak dependency target.

Rank 5 in the target profile (score 3.7143). TCGA log2FC is 7.09 and protein log2FC is 2.421. It is a cell membrane ligand of CD27. Drugs: CUSATUZUMAB PHASE_2, VORSETUZUMAB PHASE_1, VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN PHASE_1, MDX-1411 PHASE_1. Tractability is antibody and other clinical modalities (advanced clinical). Open Targets association score is 0.0572. DepMap shows no dependency (mean effect 0.251), so the case rests on a tumour-restricted surface antigen for ADC, antibody or cell-therapy approaches.

Rank 6 in the target profile (score 3.6933). TCGA log2FC is 5.557 and protein log2FC is 1.544. It localises to the apical cell membrane and is also secreted. Drug: AGS-16C3F (an antibody-drug conjugate) PHASE_2. Open Targets association score is 0.0356. DepMap shows no dependency (mean effect 0.091), so it is an antigen-type target.

Rank 3 in the target profile (score 3.7597). TCGA log2FC is 3.291 and protein log2FC is 2.279. Open Targets association score is 0.0491. No drugs are listed, though predicted tractability is 1. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency (mean effect -0.015), so it is a tractable but untested gene with a glycolysis and lactate-transport rationale.

Rank 4 in the target profile (score 3.7143), with a biomarker-profile score of 4.7744. TCGA log2FC is 4.685. The Cox log HR is 0.301 with padj 0.00479, so higher expression is associated with worse prognosis. Open Targets association score is 0.0598. No drugs are listed. DepMap mean effect is 0.316, so there is no dependency. It is best positioned as a prognostic biomarker.

Rank 9 in the target profile (score 3.5725). TCGA log2FC is 3.974 and protein log2FC is 2.106. Open Targets association score is 0.054. No drugs are listed. DepMap mean effect is -0.123 with selectivity -0.073, so there is no selective dependency. Support comes from expression and a glycolysis rationale only.

Established ccRCC target (HIF-2 alpha). Open Targets association score is 0.4871. Drug: BELZUTIFAN, max stage APPROVAL. Tractability: small molecule (approved drug) and PROTAC-type modalities. Pathway: regulation of gene expression by Hypoxia-inducible Factor. DepMap ccRCC mean effect is -0.143 against 0.157 in other lines, selectivity 0.3, padj 0.061, not a common essential, and 0.208 of ccRCC lines are dependent. The dependency is modest.

Established ccRCC target. Open Targets association score is 0.525. Drugs include RIDAFOROLIMUS (APPROVAL), GEDATOLISIB (PHASE_3), DACTOLISIB (PHASE_3), SAPANISERTIB (PHASE_2) and VISTUSERTIB (PHASE_2). DepMap ccRCC mean effect is -1.52 against -1.166 in other lines, with selectivity 0.354, padj 0.011, and 1.0 of ccRCC lines dependent. However it is flagged as a common essential, so there is a toxicity risk and a narrow therapeutic window.

Established ccRCC target (VEGFR2). Open Targets association score is 0.4566. Approved drugs include AXITINIB, TIVOZANIB HYDROCHLORIDE, CABOZANTINIB S-MALATE, PAZOPANIB HYDROCHLORIDE and LENVATINIB MESYLATE (all APPROVAL), and SUNITINIB is at PHASE_4. Tractability covers antibody and small molecule. This is the benchmark for the drug-validated class.

Top Open Targets association with ccRCC (score 0.6466). Somatic mutation in 247 of 511 tumours (freq 0.483, padj 0.0), a recurrent driver. Loss of VHL drives HIF stabilisation and so the EPAS1, CA9 and ANGPTL4 programme. It is a mechanism and not directly druggable.

Second-ranked Open Targets association (score 0.6348). Mutated in 185 of 511 tumours (freq 0.362, padj 4.59e-239), a recurrent chromatin-remodelling driver. It is a loss-of-function tumour suppressor and a stratification marker, not directly druggable.

caveats: Most top convergence genes (SCARB1, CA9, CD70, ENPP3, SLC16A3, NNMT, HK2) show no ccRCC CRISPR dependency in DepMap, so they are better biomarkers or surface antigens than inhibitor targets.
MTOR is a common essential gene, so selectivity does not remove the toxicity risk.
Open Targets association scores for convergence-ranked genes are low except for SCARB1, because they rest mainly on expression, not genetic or clinical evidence.
The EPAS1 DepMap dependency is weak (padj 0.061).

Not all top-40 genes were queried because the tool budget was limited, so PNCK, TNFAIP6, FABP6, CYP2J2 and ANGPTL4 were not profiled for druggability. The DepMap values for CA9 were returned without an evidence id and are quoted from the convergence_ranking row.
